title: Coverage-Type Changes and Premium Adjustments, TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
Under the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans**, marriage, birth, adoption or court placement recorded in DEERS lets a member-only purchaser move to member-and-family coverage, and divorce, death or loss of the last eligible family member lets a member-and-family purchaser move to member-only, where the tier allows a coverage-type change on a qualifying life event; the move is always to the tier named as that tier's change target. TRICARE Young Adult has no coverage-type change.

## Change window

The change must be requested no later than the coverage-type change window days after the life event recorded in DEERS (the window each tier lists).

- **Clock start:** the event date of the DEERS life-event record the change relies on.
- **Counting:** calendar days starting the day after the DEERS event date; the last timely day is the event date plus the window days.
- **Boundary:** a request on that last day is timely; one on the next day is not.

*Hypothetical, a window of 90 days:* DEERS marriage of 20 June 2026 - a request on 18 September 2026 is timely; a request on 19 September 2026 is not.

## Premium effect

The new coverage type takes effect on the DEERS event date. For every coverage month from the event date onward that was already billed at the old rate, the difference between the new and old monthly premium is billed (an upward change, as a coverage-type adjustment bill) or credited (a downward change, as a credit with reason coverage-type change). For the month containing the event date the difference is prorated by the days from the event date to month end over the days in that month, rounded to the cent.

- The old rate is the monthly premium of the tier held; the new rate is the monthly premium of its change-target tier. The difference is taken as a positive amount in either direction.
- The days in that month are the number of calendar days in the month containing the event date.
- A whole month already billed carries the full difference, rounded to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only (61.17) to TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family (301.82) on a DEERS marriage of 20 June; June and July already billed at the old rate.

| Month | Basis | Adjustment bill |
|---|---|---|
| June (30 days) | the difference of 240.65 multiplied by the 11 days from 20 June to month end, divided by 30 | 88.24 |
| July | the full difference | 240.65 |

Had the move been downward, the same figures would be credited with reason coverage-type change instead of billed.
